route_node_policy: Existing short 12-battle node policy, independent reward and party strategy. Original short/explore strategies preserved.
rotation: 12-second normal switch cycle: visit F03 for paid party heal, F07 for own-shield thrust, then JIA; ward requested every third cycle. Ordinary health-based emergency switching remains enabled.

background_heal_boundary.physician_support: Ordinary HEAL clamps HP and does not turn overflow into shields.
background_heal_boundary.physician_heal: Paid front skill party_heal heals each living member and turns individual overflow into personal capped shields.
background_heal_boundary.physician_ward: Paid front ward adds personal shields to living party members.

limits: One deterministic campaign reward seed and one input strategy; reproducible simulated route, not human balance acceptance.

Shield generation/absorption counters are observed lower bounds from actual 60 Hz shield changes, adjusted for recorded skill spending. Same-tick gains and absorption may cancel; no exact gross generation claim is made.
HP damage zero does not mean zero incoming hits: shields absorb substantial damage in B15–17.
Shield before terminal frame is the last live sample; temporary shields clear on victory and do not carry to B18. HP, MP, levels, XP and cooldowns preserve real records.
The final B18 first successful physician heal occurs at 12.5167s because cooldowns genuinely carry; the route does not reset or refill resources at entry.
Existing frozen short/explore routes lacked F03 due actual card selection. This independent earned route closes that specific grown-shield-build coverage gap.
